FUNC-C1.text: Core flow unusable for all users with no workaround

FUNC-C2.text: silent corruption or loss of persisted data

SEC-C1.text: Remotely exploitable without authentication: code execution, authentication bypass, bulk data exposure

PERF-C1.text: Outage or crash at expected load

PERF-C2.text: unbounded resource exhaustion any user can trigger

FUNC-H1.text: Important feature broken or wrong with only a difficult workaround

FUNC-H2.text: integrity at risk under realistic conditions (race, missing constraint on a critical entity)

SEC-H1.text: Exploitable with low-privilege access: BOLA/IDOR on sensitive data, privilege escalation, stored XSS, authenticated injection

PERF-H1.text: Critical-path p95 > 150% of objective at expected load

PERF-H2.text: leak forcing restarts within a day

A11Y-H1.text: A core journey impossible with keyboard or screen reader (WCAG A failure on a critical flow)

FUNC-M2.text: wrong validation or error handling with a workaround

SEC-M1.text: Needs user interaction or specific conditions: reflected XSS, CSRF on a non-critical action, missing rate limit on authentication, stack traces exposing internals

PERF-M1.text: Objective missed by ≤ 50%, or only under stress

A11Y-M1.text: WCAG A/AA failures on non-critical flows

SEC-L1.text: Hardening gap without a demonstrated path: missing header, vulnerable dependency proven unreachable

FUNC-I1.text: Observation or recommendation with no confirmed defect

TOOL-PROVISIONAL.text: Severity taken from the detecting tool's own mapping; provisional until a person or an agent triages the finding
